name: ad-tax-overview
description: A one-page rates card and map of the Andorran tax system for tax year 2026, read from the consolidated laws on the Portal Jurídic d'Andorra, the 2026 budget law and the Govern d'Andorra tax pages. Covers the tax year, the currency, the Departament de Tributs i de Fronteres, who is resident, personal income tax (IRPF) at 10% with the EUR 24,000 personal reduction and the 50% bonus that gives an effective 5% up to EUR 40,000, the 10% company tax (IS) and its September payment on account, non-resident tax (IRNR) rates, IGI at 4.5% with its other rates, the EUR 40,000 threshold and return frequency, CASS contribution rates, the property transfer tax, the parish (comú) taxes, late-filing surcharges, enforcement surcharges and 2026 late interest, and the main filing windows, with one worked IRPF example. Use for 'how does tax work in Andorra', 'Andorra tax overview', 'Andorra tax rates 2026'. For the detail it points to ad-income-tax, ad-corporate-income-tax, andorra-igi, ad-payroll-social,
